title: ActiveAlign: Aligning Egocentric Manipulation via Active Perception
abstract: arXiv:2610.36859v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Real2Sim2Real) enables structured world representations for planning, interpretability, and safe execution. Most existing approaches rely on passive perception, which creates real2sim gaps due to imperfect observation. Inspired by how humans perceive actively through actions, we propose ActiveAlign, a framework that leverages active perception to align the Real2Sim2Real gap from interactions. ActiveAlign introduces two complementary modules: (i) ActiveAlign-Waving, which performs hand-eye calibration by exploiting active hand motions and differentiable rendering, and (ii) ActiveAlign-Touching, which refines object alignment through tactile feedback to achieve millimeter-level precision. Together, these capabilities enable strong real2sim alignment. translated_title: ActiveAlign：通过主动感知对齐以自我为中心的操作
translated_abstract: 真实-仿真-真实（Real2Sim2Real）技术能够构建结构化的世界表征，服务于规划、可解释性和安全执行。现有方法大多依赖被动感知，由于观测的不完美而产生真实到仿真的差距。受人类通过动作进行主动感知的方式启发，我们提出了 ActiveAlign，一个利用主动感知、从交互中弥合 Real2Sim2Real 差距的框架。ActiveAlign 引入了两个互补的模块：(i) ActiveAlign-Waving，利用主动的手部运动和可微渲染来执行手眼标定；(ii) ActiveAlign-Touching，通过触觉反馈精细化物体对齐，达到毫米级精度。这些能力共同实现了强大的真实到仿真对齐。我们证明了 ActiveAlign-Waving 可用于为开源的未标定机器人操作数据集构建仿真环境，并在真实（环境中进行了演示）。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ActiveAlign 受人类主动感知启发，通过主动手部运动与可微渲染实现手眼标定、并结合触觉反馈精化物体对齐，从交互中弥合 Real2Sim2Real 差距，达到毫米级对齐精度。
en_tdlr: ActiveAlign closes the Real2Sim2Real gap through active perception—hand-eye calibration via active hand motions with differentiable rendering, plus tactile refinement of object alignment—achieving millimeter-level real-to-sim alignment.
